input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale:
Section 21 meets the preferred position in full. 21.1 sets a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 (Fees under §1.5 are the recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, and §2.1 commits USD 2,000,000 per year, so the fee-based limb is meaningful and not illusory). 21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and expressly preserves data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs as direct damages. 21.3 defines Excluded Claims — sitting outside both the cap and the exclusion — as confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not damages subject to the cap. 21.4 preserves independence of each cap and survival of exclusive-remedy failure. No competing or hidden limitation appears elsewhere (§18.2 expressly states insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities; §19.4/19.5 preserve indemnity, confidentiality, privacy and security remedies). No redline needed.</rationale>
